affected.note: Up to about 390,000 people outside the company (customers, business partners, shareholders, former employees and applicants, in Japan and overseas) possibly affected, per the 2021-01-12 third report; this figure was not updated in the final report. Confirmed leaked: 15,649 people as of the 2021-04-13 final report (revised from 16,415). Credit card data was not included.

summary.en: Capcom was hit on 2020-11-02 by a ransomware attack by a group calling itself Ragnar Locker, which encrypted data and demanded a ransom. Capcom confirmed that personal data of 15,649 people was stolen and said data of up to about 390,000 people may have been affected.
summary.ja: カプコンは2020年11月2日、「Ragnar Locker」を名乗る攻撃グループによるランサムウェア攻撃を受け、データを暗号化されたうえ身代金を要求された。同社は1万5,649人分の個人情報の流出を確認し、最大約39万人分の情報が流出した可能性があるとした。
